draft.subject: Your notification badge ticket, and next steps
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for flagging the notification badge -- that ticket is still open with our support team, and Tariq is on it. I'll keep an eye on it from my side too.

In the meantime, you've got your first project set up, which is the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, with tasks living inside them. If it would help to get the rest of your team in there, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever is most useful.

Best,
Priya
